login.title: Log in
login.heading: Log in to Throughput
login.subtitleDemo: Pick a demo role to explore instantly, or use a real account below.
login.subtitleNoDemo: Sign in with your account email and password.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.heading: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.body: Enter your email and we will send you a link to reset it, if an account exists for that address.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password
resetPassword.body: Other devices signed into this account will be logged out automatically once this is saved.

invitations.expiredBody: The link to join {{workspaceName}} was valid for 7 days. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one — your place in the workspace is still reserved.
invitations.existingAccountBody: You already have a Throughput account for this address. Accepting adds {{workspaceName}} to your workspace switcher — your existing workspaces are not affected.
